item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 23/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure and upper-air disturbances, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Upper-air disturbances are expected to depart from the coastal areas gradually over the weekend. Meanwhile, the trough of low pressure will also weaken gradually. It will be brighter over the coast of southern China, but there will still be a few showers. Another trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the coast of Guangdong again on Monday and Tuesday. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines is expected to develop gradually in the next couple of days, and move in the general direction of the seas east of Luzon.
